summary: `enable_insights_collection` (default true) registers subscription-managed nodes with Red Hat Lightspeed for AAP; set false to disable. Registry and restore: `registry_url` (default `registry.redhat.io`), `registry_username`/`registry_password` (container: required online when `registry_auth=true`, not for disconnected), `registry_verify_ssl`/`registry_tls_verify` (true); `restore_backup_file` (default `{{ setup_dir }}/automation-platform-backup-latest.tar.gz`) and `restore_file_prefix`.
questions: How do I stop AAP registering with Insights?
Do I need registry credentials for a disconnected install?
How do I disable TLS verification for the registry?
